B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting when the given denominators are unlike.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtraction.
Tag for both simple fractions and mixed-number fraction parts when denominators differ.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed.
Do not tag borrowing steps that create an equivalent fraction from a whole.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless a common denominator is also found.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number or whole number into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or expressing a whole number as a whole plus a zero-fraction part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator to align parts for subtraction.
Tag when the rewrite is done to make whole and fraction parts directly subtractable.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions between equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a step subtracts whole and fraction parts directly after setup.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps used because the fractional subtraction would be negative.
Do not tag simplification-only steps after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Borrow across mixed number
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units and adjust the whole part when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole is reduced by 1 and converted into denominator-sized fractional units.
Tag when borrowing is used after obtaining a negative or insufficient fractional part in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
Tag when the fraction part is increased by one whole in fractional form before re-subtracting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as having a zero-fraction part.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers.
Do not tag ordinary fraction subtraction when no regrouping is needed.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or recognize that a zero-fraction part simplifies to a whole number or 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by common factors after subtraction.
Tag when a result like 0 over n is simplified to 0.
Tag when a whole number is obtained by removing a zero-fraction part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that produce the unsimplified result.
Do not tag recombining whole and fraction parts unless simplification is explicitly performed there.
Do not tag common-denominator conversions before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final answer
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts and express the result in an acceptable final form such as a mixed number, fraction, integer, or 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into one final number.
Tag when a result is written as a mixed number after subtraction.
Tag when a zero whole part is omitted to present a proper fraction final answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction of whole or fraction parts before the final form is assembled.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly forms the final answer.
Do not tag setup or normalization steps.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, unlike denominators, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Normalize mixed forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number or whole number into an equivalent form that makes subtraction possible, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or writing a whole number as a whole plus a fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step rewrites a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a standard mixed number.
Tag when a step rewrites a whole number as a whole number plus 0 over a chosen denominator.
Tag when the rewritten form is used to align whole and fractional parts before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion used only to create a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Create common denominator
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and convert fractional parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag for mixed-number items when only the fractional parts are converted to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is needed.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers or whole numbers with 0 over a denominator.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in aligned form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step subtracts numerators of fractions that already share a denominator.
Tag when a step subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when the subtraction may produce zero or a negative fractional difference before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to find a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps.
Do not tag simplification or final recombination unless actual subtraction is performed in that step.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole-number part.
Tag when a borrowed whole is rewritten as denominator over denominator and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when borrowing resolves a negative or insufficient fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion.
Do not tag subtraction steps that do not involve regrouping.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or recognize that a zero fractional part yields a whole number or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step reduces a fraction such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when a step simplifies 0 over a denominator to 0 or removes a zero fractional part from a mixed number.
Tag when the final answer is rewritten in lowest terms after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction itself.
Do not tag recombining whole and fraction parts when no simplification occurs.
Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion done before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, integer, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly combines a whole-part result and a fraction-part result.
Tag when a step expresses a result like 0 and 2/5 as 2/5, or 1 and 1/5 as 1 1/5.
Tag when the final answer is stated after the parts have already been computed.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps that only perform subtraction.
Do not tag simplification of a fraction unless the step's main action is combining parts into final form.
Do not tag normalization or borrowing.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers, including common denominators, unlike denominators, borrowing, normalization of improper mixed numbers, and simplification

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators are unlike.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with a shared denominator before subtracting.
Tag for mixed-number items if only the fractional parts need denominator matching.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple subtraction of numerators after denominators are already matched.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless it also includes denominator matching.

skills.name: Normalize mixed form
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number that has an improper fractional part into a standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step changes a form like 2 3/2 into 3 1/2.
Tag when a step carries a whole from the improper fraction part to the whole-number part.
Tag when this normalization is done before the main subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary borrowing during subtraction.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator.
Do not tag simplification of a final answer.

skills.name: Set up whole-fraction parts
skills.definition: Represent quantities in aligned whole and fractional parts, including rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with a zero fractional part when needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as something like 3 + 0/5 or 2 + 0/8.
Tag when the solution explicitly separates whole parts and fraction parts for subtraction.
Tag when mixed-number subtraction is organized into whole-part subtraction and fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag denominator matching by itself.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part to the fraction part.
Do not tag final recombination unless the step is specifically about setting up aligned parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts are subtracted in mixed-number problems.
Tag when a step performs the main subtraction after setup, whether for simple fractions or separated mixed-number parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag finding an LCD or converting equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping to fix a negative fractional difference.
Do not tag simplification of the result.

skills.name: Borrow in subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when a step changes a result like 1 and -1/5 into 0 and 4/5.
Tag when borrowing is used in whole-minus-fraction or mixed-number subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.
Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce a fractional result to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction result to a whole number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0 or when a whole plus 0 over a denominator is written as an integer.
Tag when the final answer is explicitly rewritten in lowest terms.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction step that produced the unsimplified fraction.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts if no reduction or whole-number conversion occurs.
Do not tag normalization or borrowing.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into one answer.
Tag when a result like 0 and 2/5 is written as 2/5.
Tag when a mixed-number result is assembled after subtraction and any needed borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction of the parts themselves.
Do not tag simplification alone unless the step also explicitly recombines parts.
Do not tag setup steps that only separate whole and fraction parts.
